schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Batch every non-major update (Docker digest/patch/minor + GitHub Actions) into ONE weekly PR and automerge it once the 14-day cooldown has passed and CI is green. This is a template repo, so no running service is affected.
Major updates: keep as separate PRs, label them, and require a human to review and merge (potential breaking changes).

Keep MySQL on the LTS track. Oracle alternates LTS releases (8.4, supported for years) with Innovation releases (8.1-8.3, 9.x) that reach EOL as soon as the next one ships. Without this constraint Renovate happily upgrades to an Innovation release - it already moved this repo from 8.0 LTS to the EOL 8.3. Capping below 9 keeps it on 8.4; moving to the next LTS is a deliberate human step, since MySQL supports in-place upgrade but NOT downgrade.

The Tinybird helper image is built from this repo by publish-tinybird.yml, scanned before push, and provenance-attested. Its digest is ours, not a third party's, so the 14-day supply-chain cooldown does not apply - pin the new digest as soon as it is published. Listed last so it overrides the batching rules above.
